rows.name: engine_watchdog_help
rows.tail:
usage: scubiee engine [-h] [--host HOST] [--port PORT] [--wait WAIT]
                      [--no-open] [--logon] [--off]
                      {start,stop,status,run,ensure,watchdog,supervisor,autostart}
                      [path]

positional arguments:
  {start,stop,status,run,ensure,watchdog,supervisor,autostart}
                        Daemon action (supervisor = logon loop; watchdog = in-
                        session sidecar)
  path                  Default repo for open

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --host HOST
  --port PORT
  --wait WAIT           Health wait seconds (start)
  --no-open             run: do not open repo on start
  --logon               supervisor: enter standby and stop leftover GPU
                        (scheduled-task path)
  --off                 autostart: unregister the logon supervisor task
